verdict: NEGATIVE. Closed by a kill condition frozen in advance.
question_the_cycle_asked: A fixed-depth model must pay the worst case on every example. If a task's required depth
genuinely varies per example, and is discoverable only by working rather than announced in
the input, can a model that decides its own depth beat the fixed-depth model at matched
accuracy, matched parameters and matched training budget?

task.name: chase_to_goal
task.definition: A permutation defines a single cycle through 24 nodes. The model starts somewhere on it and must report how many hops away node 0 is, up to 8.
why_this_task: Difficulty is a property of the datum, not of a knob. The answer is discoverable only by
following the chain, so depth cannot be read off the input.
A guessing baseline is 0.136. An earlier task design was discarded because it was
unsolvable: the model was never given the information needed to disambiguate the target,
and all ten candidate models returned exactly 0.1441.

architectures.name: Q1Elastic
architectures.note: ponder collapse; a negative halt-bias initialisation did not cure it

architectures.name: Q2Commit
architectures.note: recovers the accuracy the mixture loses, but only by spending full depth, so it buys no saving

architectures.name: Q3Arrival
architectures.mechanism: halt on detected arrival; the halt step is the answer
architectures.accuracy: 0.9994-1.0000 on 6 of 10 seeds, 0.42-0.51 on the other 4

architectures.name: Q4Grounded
architectures.mechanism: Q3 plus a training-only per-step position readout, zero inference cost

what_was_established.statement: Mixture halting collapses where commit halting does not. Q1 caps at 0.6241; changing only the halting rule to a hard straight-through commit lifts the same core to 0.9999. This was a single-variable intervention at a fixed seed and is a claim about the contrast, not about attainment.

Halting on detected arrival, with the halt step as the answer, does produce a genuine 1.77x inference-compute reduction at matched accuracy AND fewer parameters -- when it trains. Seeds 0, 2 and 3 reproduce it to within 0.0006 accuracy and 0.00 steps.

what_was_established.status: holds, and defeats C2 as a reportable result
what_was_established.statement: Q3 trains to that result on 6 of 10 seeds. The fixed-depth baseline reaches >=0.99 on 10 of 10 under identical conditions, minimum 0.9919, so the unreliability belongs to the architecture and not to the task. Expected accuracy across seeds is 0.78 for Q3 against 1.00 for Q0.

The failure mode is silent and mimics success. Collapsed Q3 runs report 5.2-6.1 average steps: a plausible, non-degenerate, adaptive-looking allocation well under the fixed depth of 8. All thirteen failed runs look healthy if only the step counter is read. A compute-saving figure reported without a matched accuracy figure cannot distinguish a working elastic model from a broken one.

Q3's bimodality is not caused by a state that fails to track position. Supplying position directly (Q4) removed the collapse mode -- no run below 0.6322 -- and removed the good mode with it, best run 0.9500. An auxiliary signal that reduces seed variance can do so by destroying the solution worth having.

what_remains_open: Whether Q3's result depends on the answer coinciding with the step count. The Q3b control was specified and not run; the question is OPEN and no claim may be made in either direction.
Finding V4: chase_to_goal and chase_to_goal_weighted induce the same distance distribution under uniform weights, yet Q3 succeeds on 6 of 10 versus 1 of 10. Unexplained.

Whether adaptive depth wins on a workload with a much wider depth spread, where the fixed-depth worst case is far more wasteful. Not attempted: the blocker measured here is reliability, and there is no reason to expect deeper chains to improve it.
branches_of_the_3.0_directive_not_attemp: Complex-field / optical-spectral computation. The Q-Neuro 2.0 evidence (FAIL-005) already showed the complex advantage vanishes against a best-real envelope, so this branch was deprioritised rather than merely skipped.
Sub-agent and collective-field computation; homeostasis and self-repair; distillation; multi-objective Pareto training beyond the accuracy/compute frontier measured here.
These are recorded as NOT DONE. Cycle 1 consumed its budget establishing that the first architecture family fails, which is the outcome the programme is designed to surface early rather than late.
